kurals.tr: Vaaimai Enappatuvadhu Yaadhenin Yaadhondrum / Theemai Ilaadha Solal
kurals.m: Truth is the speaking of such words as are free from the least degree of evil (to others)

kurals.tr: Poimaiyum Vaaimai Yitaththa Puraidheerndha / Nanmai Payakkum Enin
kurals.m: Even falsehood has the nature of truth, if it confer a benefit that is free from fault

kurals.tr: Thannenj Charivadhu Poiyarka Poiththapin / Thannenje Thannaich Chutum
kurals.m: Let not a man knowingly tell a lie; for after he has told the lie, his mind will burn him (with the memory of his guilt)

kurals.tr: Ullaththaar Poiyaa Thozhukin Ulakaththaar / Ullaththu Lellaam Ulan
kurals.m: He who, in his conduct, preserves a mind free from deceit, will dwell in the minds of all men

kurals.tr: Manaththotu Vaaimai Mozhiyin Thavaththotu / Thaananjey Vaarin Thalai
kurals.m: He, who speaks truth with all his heart, is superior to those who make gifts and practise austerities

kurals.tr: Poiyaamai Anna Pukazhillai Eyyaamai / Ellaa Aramun Tharum
kurals.m: There is no praise like the praise of never uttering a falsehood: without causing any suffering, it will lead to every virtue

kurals.tr: Poiyaamai Poiyaamai Aatrin Arampira / Seyyaamai Seyyaamai Nandru
kurals.m: If a man has the power to abstain from falsehood, it will be well with him, even though he practise no other virtue

kurals.tr: Puraldhooimai Neeraan Amaiyum Akandhooimai / Vaaimaiyaal Kaanap Patum
kurals.m: Purity of body is produced by water and purity of mind by truthfulness

kurals.tr: Ellaa Vilakkum Vilakkalla Saandrorkkup / Poiyaa Vilakke Vilakku
kurals.m: All lamps of nature are not lamps; the lamp of truth is the lamp of the wise

kurals.tr: Yaameyyaak Kantavatrul Illai Enaiththondrum / Vaaimaiyin Nalla Pira
kurals.m: Amidst all that we have seen (described) as real (excellence), there is nothing so good as truthfulness
